body:
Closed the last built-but-unwired mod gap from this session's own "make sure to tie parena mods deep in as we go" mandate -- paper_fragment_mod (the destructible-geometry decision layer) was built and tested earlier but never called by the running game, same gap level_mod/talent_mod/stat_effects_mod all had until wired in earlier today.

Shipped: PC_PACKET_INTERACT (bare punch keypress, server derives hit point from player position+yaw, no aim data) + PC_TEST_CUBE_* -- one real, world-positioned 96-fragment PAPER_MATERIAL_CONCRETE prop spawned server-side at chunk-local (12,8), ground-anchored the same way player spawn is. PcSnapshotPacket broadcasts only per-fragment STATE (not geometry) since both client and server independently regenerate the identical deterministic mesh from a shared seed. apps/server calls the real, already-tested paper_mesh_damage_radius -> the real PARENA-compiled on_paper_fragment_damage/on_paper_fragment_state_for_hp decide outcomes, not host C. apps/client renders it live (E to punch).

Verified live end-to-end via a real UDP probe (login as test@test.com -> real IDUNA ticket -> CONNECT -> walk to the cube's real world position -> send real PC_PACKET_INTERACT once in reach): server log confirmed real spawn ("Real Paper Engine test cube spawned at (12.0,66.5,8.0) -- 96 fragments", Y correctly ground-derived), probe's own snapshot readback showed 5 real fragments transition INTACT->CRACKED->GONE within about a second of real punching.

bazel build //... and bazel test //... both clean: 12 targets, all 5 mod tests passing. Added the missing //packages/simulation:paper_fragment dep to both apps/server and apps/client BUILD.bazel cc_binary targets.

NORTHSTAR.md and docs/NORTHSTAR_PAPER_ENGINE.md updated to document this as shipped and verified.

Commits: 0fc1021 (feat), 285af56 (changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: Paper Engine live-wired into the actual game loop, verified end-to-end
